name: UniversalCam
subtitle: Use your iPhone as a wireless camera for your PC

apps.name: UniversalCam
apps.versionDescription: Initial release. Stream your iPhone camera to your Windows PC over WiFi with low-latency H.264 video and AAC audio.
apps.localizedDescription: UniversalCam turns your iPhone into a wireless camera for your Windows PC. It streams H.264 video and AAC audio over QUIC with ultra-low latency on your local network.

permissions.usageDescription: UniversalCam uses your camera to stream video to your Windows PC.
UniversalCam uses your microphone to stream audio to your Windows PC.
UniversalCam connects to your Windows PC on the local network.
UniversalCam continues streaming when in the background.
